author: K. L. Pryor
title: Kasson-Mantorville Elementary School reports 154 third-graders took 2024-25 mathematics MCA
text:
The Minnesota Department of Education reports that third-grade students at Kasson-Mantorville Elementary School had the highest participation rate in the mathematics section of the 2024-25 MCA.
There were 154 third-graders among the 317 students who participated in the mathematics portion at Kasson-Mantorville Elementary School for 2024-25.
Based on test standards, 81% of Kasson-Mantorville’s third-graders scored at proficient levels in mathematics.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are state-administered tests that assess progress aligned with Minnesota’s academic standards, and help meet both federal and state law requirements. These assessments cover math, reading, and science by grade level. Most students take the MCA, though eligible special education students may instead participate in the Alt MCA.
Statewide proficiency rates for Minnesota’s MCA exams have dropped from pre-pandemic levels , as reported by Minnesota’s Report Card. Math proficiency decreased by over 7% since 2019, while reading proficiency declined by nearly 5%.
